title: Amsterdam Centraal
axis: +X follows the platforms east-southeast. Positive Z faces the Stationsplein and Damrak city side. Negative Z faces the IJ and the bus canopy.
limits: The PMTiles footprints set the position of the historic frontage and four long roofs. The six-meter datum follows standard viewer terrain. Facade ornaments and most elevations are exterior photo estimates.

The exterior includes the visible platform canopies, glazed end screens, rail platforms and the raised IJ bus deck. Platform fittings and roof lettering are simplified at viewer scale. Active rail, streets, ferry water and surrounding buildings stay in the underlying map.
